note: Adopted upstream fix 0e8566814, then 9.2.0: control-plane JWT settings are fixed at startup, so a PUT turning JWT on with an unreadable key source is ignored with one WARN per property and the control plane stays open (confirmed on the 9.2.0 oracle: 200, 200, 200 and the two WARNs)

stdoutInOrder: controlPlaneJWTAuthenticationRequired is fixed at startup and cannot be changed on a running server (it decides who may use the control plane, so a request to the control plane cannot change it) - the supplied value true has been IGNORED and controlPlaneJWTAuthenticationRequired remains false

controlPlaneJWTAuthenticationJWKSource is fixed at startup and cannot be changed on a running server (it decides who may use the control plane, so a request to the control plane cannot change it) - the supplied value "/no/such/mock-server-320-jwks.json" has been IGNORED and controlPlaneJWTAuthenticationJWKSource remains ""
